title.narrative: Support for the Reconstruction of Communities in the Central African Republic

description.narrative: UNOPS offers procurement support and delivery of vehicles and medical equipment (specifically an MRI machine) for the "Programme d’Appui à la Reconstruction des Communautés de Base Phase II (PARCB-2)" in the Central African Republic. This program is financed by the African Development Bank to support the reconstruction of communities suffering from significant transportation and access to essential services like healthcare, education, and markets.
